label: Weekly Review
topic: Weekly Review / 本周复习 (未知因数＋剩余＋比较效率＋分配律×25＋中括号)
formulas: Rate × Time = Work；Remaining = Total − Done (剩余工作量)
Compare rates: find each person's work ÷ time, then subtract (比较效率)
Missing factor: □ = product ÷ known factor (未知因数)
[ ] then ( ): brackets first (带中括号四则)

questions.title: 求未知因数
questions.q: 求未知因数：□ × 32 = 5984。方框里应填哪一个数？
questions.mistakes: 估商偏低（少估 10 或 20）；未用乘法检验。

questions.title: Remaining work
questions.q: There are 9360 name tags to stick on gifts. Emma sticks 384 name tags per hour. After she works for 11 hours, how many name tags are still left?
questions.explanation: Done = rate × time = 384 × 11. 384 × 10 = 3840 and 384 × 1 = 384, so 3840 + 384 = 4224 name tags done. Remaining = 9360 − 4224 = 5136 name tags.

wrong.B: 4224 is how many Emma already stuck (384 × 11), not how many are left. Subtract from the total: 9360 − 4224 = 5136.
wrong.C: 8976 is 9360 − 384 (only one hour). She worked 11 hours: done = 384 × 11 = 4224, left = 5136.
wrong.D: 5520 is 9360 − 3840, which only subtracts 10 hours of work (384 × 10 = 3840). Include the 11th hour: 9360 − 4224 = 5136.

questions.mistakes: Reporting done instead of remaining; subtracting only one hour; forgetting the extra hour after multiplying by 10.

questions.title: 比较效率
questions.q: 小华 9 小时包装了 3510 个礼盒，赵叔叔 8 小时包装了 3280 个礼盒。谁的工作效率更高？每小时相差多少个？

options.A: 小华更高，每小时多 20 个
options.B: 赵叔叔更高，每小时多 20 个
options.D: 赵叔叔更高，每小时多 230 个

questions.explanation: 先求每人每小时的效率：小华 3510 ÷ 9 = 390（个/小时）；赵叔叔 3280 ÷ 8 = 410（个/小时）。410 − 390 = 20，所以赵叔叔效率更高，每小时多 20 个。

wrong.A: 小华每小时 390 个，比赵叔叔的 410 个少，不是更高。差确实是 20 个，但更高的是赵叔叔。
wrong.C: 两人效率不一样：390 ≠ 410。赵叔叔每小时多 20 个。
wrong.D: 230 是两人总量的差（3510 − 3280 = 230），不是每小时效率的差。应先各自除以时间：410 − 390 = 20。

questions.mistakes: 用总量比较而不是先求每小时效率；算对了差但弄反了谁更快。

questions.title: Distributive ×25
questions.q: Use a smart method to calculate 672 × 25. Which result is correct?

wrong.D: 13440 is 672 × 20. Still need another ×5, or use ×100 ÷ 4 → 16800.

questions.mistakes: Treating ×25 as ×10; multiplying by 100 and forgetting to ÷4; only multiplying by 20.

questions.title: 中括号四则

wrong.D: 2880 是 60×48，把最后要乘的 56 错用成了括号里的 48。正确是 60 × 56 = 3360。

questions.mistakes: 忘记先算小括号里的减法；运算顺序出错；最后一步用错乘数。

questions.title: Plan vs actual
questions.q: Mrs. Brown planned to pack 12600 juice boxes in 14 days. She actually finished all 12600 juice boxes in 9 days. How many more juice boxes did she pack per day than planned?
questions.explanation: Planned rate: 12600 ÷ 14 = 900 juice boxes per day. Actual rate: 12600 ÷ 9 = 1400 juice boxes per day. Difference: 1400 − 900 = 500 more juice boxes per day than planned.

wrong.B: 900 is the planned daily rate, not how many more she packed. Actual is 1400, so more = 1400 − 900 = 500.
wrong.C: 1400 is the actual daily rate, not the difference. More = 1400 − 900 = 500.
wrong.D: 2520 comes from dividing the total by the days saved: 12600 ÷ (14 − 9) = 2520. That is not the extra per day. Compare the two rates: 1400 − 900 = 500.

questions.mistakes: Reporting the planned or actual rate instead of the difference; dividing the total by the days saved instead of comparing daily rates.
